# mctl-telegram — Remote MCP Server for Telegram

> `mctl-telegram` is a hosted Remote MCP connector for Telegram. It allows users to securely interact with their Telegram account via ChatGPT Apps, Claude.ai, or any MCP client with OAuth 2.1 authentication and preview-only safety controls.

## Key Resources & Submissions

- [Public Documentation](https://tg.mctl.ai/docs): Getting started and tool documentation.
- [Security & Trust Model](https://tg.mctl.ai/security): Data minimization and session encryption details.
- [ChatGPT App Directory Submission](https://github.com/mctlhq/mctl-telegram/blob/main/chatgpt-submission-package.md): Reviewer notes and submission package.
- [Claude Connector Submission](https://github.com/mctlhq/mctl-telegram/blob/main/claude-connector-submission.md): Anthropic Remote MCP directory submission metadata.

## Tools Summary (14 MCP Tools)

- `list_dialogs`: Read-only list of dialogs.
- `get_messages` & `get_unread_messages`: Read-only message history and unread items.
- `send_message`: Write tool (Preview-only dry-run by default unless `send_enabled=true`).
- `prepare_pin_message` & `pin_message`: Confirmed pinning with dry-run protection.
- `get_my_audit_log`: Cryptographic tamper-evident hash-chain audit log.
- `disconnect_telegram_account` & `delete_telegram_account`: Account revocation and data deletion.
